name: Bottled Levels
summary: Pour your experience into glass bottles at an enchanting table, keep it for later or hand it to a friend.
logoPrompt: A single glass bottle filled with glowing green experience orbs and a cork stopper, small green sparkles around it, centred, in blocky voxel style

bullets: Throw one to get it back

description: **Bottled Levels turns your experience into bottles you can store in a chest, carry to the next enchanting session or give to another player.**
- Each filled bottle takes 50 experience points from you and holds 45 of them.
- Throw it, or shoot it from a dispenser, and it releases exactly the amount it holds.
- The bottle shows its amount below its name, and filled bottles stack with each other.
- Plain Bottles o' Enchanting work as before.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Hold a glass bottle, sneak and right-click an enchanting table.
- 10% of the points are lost on bottling, so experience is never copied.
- With fewer than 50 points nothing happens and a short hint appears.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
